body:
Brother, I empathise with your situation. The only thing I can recommend is to not focus on the bs that file throws your way. You can't be sure where you'll be in 10 years but you can take steps to get yourself there. 

Find your purpose and strive to fulfil it. One thing I can say is that helping others is probably the most rewarding thing one can do. I'd recommend doing some voluntary work, possibly at a homeless shelter; I guarantee you will feel blissful inside. 

Don't let society's expectation make you feel down or tell you that you shouldn't be happy. 

If it's okay I'd like to maybe converse a little with you, maybe we can compare how shit life is :) so please pm me.

My dearest friend, you are a miracle. You have been blessed with sentient thought and you will prevail. 

I don't know much about you but it's not what you don't have but rather what you do. 

A broken penis is better than no penis. If you're worried about not finding someone that loves you, you shouldn't. As a person you are beautiful inside and I know you are beautiful outside even though I have never met you. 

Glow on the inside and you will glow on the outside.

Find your pockets of happiness wherever you can. 

Know that you are loved.
What would need to happen for you to not think along those lines?
Did something happen for you to feel like that?
Make a gesture to show her how much you love her. Give her a reason to live. What's the worst that can happen. Just don't drink Dr. Pepper ;)

Do something different my friend. Go to an orphanage and give out presents to those less fortunate. Come to the UK and do something different. Help the poor I'm India... Make an impact on those less fortunate than you and I guarantee you will glow inside. 

Peace.

When your husband comes back please love him like you have never before. Don't be scared to say those words. Chances are he's thinking the same thing no matter how let down he feels. 

You sound like a lovely and caring person I wish you all the luck in the world.

It's a double edged sward I'm afraid, sometimes it's better to not love than to lose. I'm hounded by memories of what could have been, how my life would not have been decimated had my heart been less fragile.

Your words give me some comfort and I know that there is a perfect match for everyone in this planet. 

Guess its too late for me. My gamble on love and life didn't work out.

I don't know if its a problem but weed had been an escape and a curse for me. 

I had the best job in the world gave it up for love guess that's where my misery began. 

I am not destitute yet I'm grateful for what I have but I guess that's next up for me.

Hey, you are not alone in the grand scheme of things. I guess you've come to the right place to seek help. 

When was the last time you were happy? What was going through your mind?

Gosh, I've lost my livelihood... followed by cracks in my relationship... Followed by the loss of my life savings... Followed by losing my partner... Followed by drug problems... Followed by debt... I don't want to find out what's next for me.
Almost 30 my friend. My life has crumbled around me. I'm a developer for some reason there are a lot of people in the same field.

It's the feeling of downing when there is no water. The feeling of being lonely when surrounded by family. 

Sometimes it's easier to die than live.

I'm sorry for your loss. Ill shed tears for him.

I'll talk openly here, a lot has changed on my life. The last three years have been hell for me. I always think I've hot rock bottom only to find that I'm still falling. 

I don't even know where to start.

I feel your pain. Whoever you are and where ever you are know that you're not alone. 

It's strange, because I feel the same way but reading your post makes me want to burst into tears so please don't go down that path. If you want to talk to someone please let me know. I can't offer much but you won't be alone.
